title: Expectation versus Surprise Taiwan PIT feasibility across expectation-source classes

sourceClasses.guard: Preserve complete distribution; do not choose mean/median/mode after seeing realization or returns.

priorItem.fact: Issuer disclosed IND submission; stated FDA review process, default 30-day activation unless clinical hold, and conditional next-step scenarios.

realizationItem.fact: Issuer confirmed HCB303 IND allowed to proceed to human clinical trial.

sourceClasses.guard: No scalar probability or surprise magnitude is fabricated because the prior disclosure did not provide probabilities.

sourceClasses.priorState: 2026-05-27 shareholder approval authorized up to 2,000,000 restricted shares; regulatory effectiveness disclosed as 2026-08-13.

realizationItem.fact: First issuance set at 516,000 shares with 2026-10-05 capital-increase record date.

sourceClasses.guard: Authorization ceiling is not an expected issuance quantity and cannot be treated as a consensus denominator.
Market price reaction, media tone or realized outcome cannot back-solve a missing expectation.

frozenContract: Expectation evidence must be captured before realization.
Expected and realized objects must use compatible definitions and units for numeric surprise.
Full distributions are retained when available.
Categorical scenario sets remain categorical unless ex-ante probabilities exist.
Authorization/range/opportunity-set evidence does not equal expected magnitude.
Post-event return is never used to infer surprise.
falsification: A fully anticipated event can still move prices; source-feasible surprise does not guarantee zero market reaction.
A positive corporate milestone may be inside the prior scenario set and still have unknown numeric surprise.
A realized issuance below an authorization ceiling is not automatically a positive surprise because the ceiling is not an expectation.
Different event families cannot share one surprise scale without an explicit cross-family normalization contract.

maturityDecision.basis: Taiwan PIT sources now demonstrate three distinct ex-ante expectation classes—full distributions, categorical conditional scenarios, and authorization-with-unknown-magnitude—plus an explicit no-source UNKNOWN state. Realization objects are independently sourceable without reading equity outcomes.

exactNext: Prospectively capture new expectation/realization pairs across additional event families before outcomes.
Preregister any numeric surprise function by event family.
Collect genuinely unexpected realizations and failed/delayed/cancelled scenarios rather than only modal-success cases.
Test incremental value only after common-support controls for event class, D17-07 expectation evidence state and D11 event identity.
